title: Seeking A Friend For The End Of The World (Video (Standard))
description: This lovely script was written by u/endlessgin, in it, the end of the world is nigh. The chaos in society is reaching the end game, and so being the person I am, I figure I'll pop on top of my roof to watch it all go down. Of course, sharing experiences is always more fun, even if they are your last - so I invite you over to enjoy the end times with me... and we both end up enjoying them quite a bit! No time to work on your bucket list quite like the end of the world!
author: Mistress Shibby
